run_load_directory: run load_dir.py on a directory to generate Boost.Build test code that recreates its file structure
create_boost_test_scaffold: create a Boost.Build test scaffold by running load_dir.py on a source directory to output t.write calls
remove_first_path_component: remove the first component from a file path using the remove_first_component function
generate_test_write_calls: generate t.write calls for all files in a directory tree using the create_file function
review_load_dir_main: review the main function to understand how load_dir.py walks directories and prints test scaffolding
